title: Contextual Infobar Help for Cost Drilldown — visual spec, prototype & stakeholder review
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Users get lost when they dive into tokenized cost drilldowns and then trigger an action (filter, rollback budget, or snapshot compare). There is no persistent contextual guidance explaining what changed, why costs spiked, or how to safely revert a view. Scope: design a compact contextual infobar that sits above drilldown results and surfaces: 1) the query state (filters + timeframe), 2) an inline explanation (microcopy) for anomalies, 3) a one-click lightweight action (copy link / pin snapshot / revert filter), and 4) a collapsed help affordance that opens the detailed panel. Deliverables: annotated visual specs, interactive Figma prototype (desktop + mobile), microcopy baseline, accessibility notes, and a dev/QA handoff package.
acceptance_criteria: Infobar appears consistently at top of drilldown and persists across paginated results
Infobar shows filter chips summary, timeframe, and one-line anomaly explanation when regression detected
Primary action button supports developer hook (data-route param) and has accessible label
Collapsed help expands to a side panel with step-by-step guidance and links to relevant dashboards
Figma prototype demonstrates animation states: appear/dismiss/collapse/expand and keyboard focus order
Design tokens and spacing callouts included for engineering handoff
QA checklist passes visual diff and keyboard-only navigation tests
Microcopy team has approved baseline strings and a short localization note
decisions: Use compact infobar variant (32px height) to avoid pushing content; expand to full 72px when help is open
Primary action is contextual: defaults to 'Pin snapshot' for anomalous results and 'Copy query link' for normal drilldowns
Color treatment: low-contrast taupe background with 1px border for subtle separation; anomaly state uses amber left accent stripe
Avoid modal for help; prefer slide-over side panel to preserve context and allow deep linking
Tooltip-level microcopy kept under 90 characters; detailed explanations in side panel

Eng - Priya Patel (2026-03-04): Need a clear data-route param for pin and copy actions; also surface a 400ms debounce on appear to avoid flicker during live queries
Analytics - Mateo Cruz (2026-03-05): Track three new events: infobar_shown, infobar_primary_click, infobar_help_open. Include the active_filter_set in payload
Accessibility - Simone DuBois (2026-03-06): Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text on anomaly stripe and keyboard trap avoided when panel opens
Design Director - Lina Park (2026-03-08): Visual polish looks good; tighten type scale for small screens and reduce icon weight in primary action

qa_checklist: Infobar shows/hides consistently across three browser widths (desktop, tablet, narrow)
Primary action has accessible name and is reachable via Tab order
Slide-over panel can be opened/closed via keyboard and Esc key returns focus to triggering element
Anomaly stripe and text meet contrast thresholds
Event firing validated in analytics console for the three key events
Microcopy localization flags present for i18n team
accessibility_notes: Use role=status for the infobar container with aria-live=polite for dynamic microcopy. Ensure focus is not trapped when the help panel closes. All interactive elements must have visible focus styles and 4.5:1 contrast minimum for text over background.
visual_changes: Introduce 8px rounded corners on the infobar container to match console cards
Add subtle 1px drop shadow when the help panel is open to imply depth
Reduce icon stroke to 1.25px for small screens as per design director feedback
